phase: formula-pass (blind; stage A packet only; no claims seen)

identity.normalization: Canonical list one entry per ingredient; 'Maris Sal (Dead Sea Salt)' is one entry (synonym in parentheses). Normalized one-based positions (ID-2) = packet positions.
identity.e3ProminenceCutoff: No Parfum/Fragrance declared; E3 preservative fallback = Sodium Benzoate @8. Prominent = positions 1-7.

surfactants.c3Class: no C3 cleansing class (fatty-alcohol ethoxylate; C3 nonionic cleansing covers alkyl glucosides only, and the chemistry-name rule names no ethoxylate class)
surfactants.role: not a cleansing route, not a buffer; E4 comfort route as Polidocanol (v1.6.2)

formulaFacts.mildBase: Not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 excludes MB.
formulaFacts.csa: Met via listed prominent routes (comfort: Laureth-9@3 = Polidocanol, Urea@6; humectant: Urea@6). MB not used (excluded). Cooling agent Menthol@12 and Mentha Arvensis Leaf Oil@16 are not prominent, so they are not CSA counter-signals under the E3 reading; recorded as exposure facts.

wLine.plausibility: No candidate at positions 1-7 (no fragrance, no listed allergen, no class-b/c ingredient). E3 marker Sodium Benzoate@8 is itself a class-b candidate: (i) SLES@2 listed before; (ii) nothing lies between it and the cap. Plausible; W-line = cap, no fallback code.
wLine.note: No payload_lipid; the W-line gates nothing here.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 with one prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine@5 and no reinforcing strong anionic. Laureth-9@3 is in no C3 cleansing class and does not change the count; read as a buffer it would not change the value either.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system (prominent cationic guar Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@7) with humectants Urea@6, Glycerin@9, Panthenol@14. C2 not met (no silicone, payload lipid or pearlizing route). Neighbor low: guar is the only substantive route and sits at the E3 boundary in a salt-heavy, cleansing-led base.

excluded: Laureth-9@3 (nonionic ethoxylate/comfort active, no deposition role)

weightPotential.wLine: Sodium Benzoate@8 (= cap); no payload_lipid to split.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - a single cationic guar; no other deposition family.
weightPotential.persistence: low - one light polymer route, no silicone/lipid.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Guar is prominent (position 7); guar can build up over repeated use.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low anchor: a single deposition family without a reinforcing route facing a moderate reset (no polymer floor, W2).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: the only depositing route is one cationic guar; no second family, no silicone, lipid, protein or film former converges, and the SLES/betaine reset is moderate.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (moderate confidence): single guar route against moderate reset.

careDirection.limitation: Blind; relevant only if a lengths moisture/repair claim appears. Humectants beyond Urea are after the E3 point.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Comfort routes (Polidocanol/Laureth-9@3, Urea@6) plus a cooling agent suggest an itch/scalp role, but focus needs a claim (3.2).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula-compatible routes: scalp_active (comfort routes, CSA met), moisture (urea + guar). Decision: provisional general pending claims.
focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): general; scalp_active is the most plausible formula-compatible alternative.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): default regular. Cleansing not strong, so frequent open under U2; alternating and treatment impossible from the formula.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): no positioning visible. CSA formula half met via listed prominent comfort routes Laureth-9@3 (INCI of the listed Polidocanol, v1.6.2) and Urea@6 (also humectant route). MB not met (SLES@2). Menthol@12/Mentha Arvensis Leaf Oil@16 are non-prominent exposure facts. Becomes targeted with an SC1 sensitive/dry-scalp unit graded moderate/high.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: no Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole, Selenium Sulfide or Selenium Disulfide; menthol/salt do not upgrade it.

uncertainties: Laureth-9@3 C3 class: assigned to no cleansing class (fatty-alcohol ethoxylate; C3 nonionic cleansing = alkyl glucosides). Alternative: nonionic buffer. No effect on cleansingStrength (C1 already buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine@5) or on MB (SLES@2 excludes it).

Menthol@12 is after the E3 point; under the E3 reading it is not a prominent cooling counter-signal for CSA. If the reveal shows strong cooling positioning, confidence of targeted (if reached) still follows the CSA counter-signal rule only for prominent agents.
